callouts.label: Flat red slats define the 3 x 3 x 6 m room
callouts.quote: Flat red vertical slats preserve its simple interior.

callouts.label: Paired 36 mm chords around a separate web layer
callouts.quote: Paired chords straddle a single web layer, and each panel has real triangulation.

callouts.label: Faceted truss depth varies across and along the roof
callouts.quote: Each rib changes depth across the room and elevation along the series.

callouts.label: Short straight slats cover the planar roof facets
callouts.quote: Straight short boards can cover the facets; an arbitrary doubly curved skin would require twisted stock.

callouts.label: Level ceiling; face fixings require connection design
callouts.quote: The ceiling is face-fixed beneath lower chords, requiring fasteners; it is not described as bearing on a support above it.

callouts.label: One 0.90 x 2.10 m entrance with supported header
callouts.quote: Header and jamb assemblies carry boards above the single entrance.

callouts.label: Explicit bracing connects the transverse frames
callouts.quote: Longitudinal ties and diagonals connect frames; separate roof and floor-plane diagonals collect shear.

callouts.label: Sole runners fit within the crossed timber mat
callouts.quote: A focused Designer review resolved the conflict by integrating continuous sole runners into the existing upper layer at z = -0.060 to -0.024 m.
